subject: peony
name: 牡丹
label: 侧开的牡丹
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One elegant half-open peony in three-quarter view, ten large layered petals with clear negative spaces, a strong curved stem and three lobed leaves.
Composition check: complete subject centered inside the central 76% of the square with generous 12% clear margins. Pure black contour lines, open white interiors, no shading. Respect the low number of parts specified, no dense repeated small decorations.
